newsitem.title: USA: Tuesday Morning Q3 sales increase.
newsitem.headline: Tuesday Morning Q3 sales increase.

text.p: Tuesday Morning Corp said Tuesday morning it posted record sales in the third quarter of $48.5 million compared with $38.2 million in the same period last year.
Same-store sales increased 18 percent for the quarter and rose 12 percent for the nine months to date, the discount retail chain said.
Sales for the nine months ended September 22 increased 19 percent, to $138.5 million, compared with $116.2 milion for the same period in 1995.
